## Use this when

- analyze this messy ERP export
- migrate our spreadsheets without losing provenance
- map CSV data before replacing our system
- find conflicts in our business exports
- reconcile records from multiple business systems
- stage an ERP migration without overwriting anything

## Problem

A business needs to ingest and understand messy operational exports while preserving source lineage, surfacing conflicts and avoiding destructive migration assumptions.

## Inputs

Authenticated tenant CSV/structured exports or connector-fed records.

## Outputs

ImportRun, SourceRecord, mapping preview, explicit ImportConflict records and review state.

## Pricing

No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.

Shadow import does not overwrite the source or silently create canonical truth. Private records require authenticated tenant access.
